   (one paragraph, 60-400 chars) and three steps workspace.intro-step-1/2/3. Say plainly what happens: you type what
   you want built; the same Meta model builds it twice — once as a single AI call, once as EvoForge (a Critic writes
   tests, the Builder retries against them); hidden acceptance tests decide which result is better, with the cost of
   each side shown. English text must mention "single" and "test". Korean translation too.
3. Replace internal codes in text users read, in en.json AND ko.json values and in literal JSX text under
   apps/web/app/[locale] and apps/web/components: X_SINGLE -> "single AI baseline", PIPELINE -> "EvoForge pipeline",

   check", "integrity gate"). Keep message KEYS unchanged (code reads them); change only values/visible text. API
   values such as kind "X_SINGLE" in requests or comparisons stay as they are (they are not user text).
Keep tsc green and every web-structure test green (many tests read these files; keep what they check).
